item.title: Daily Briefing — July 26, 2026
item.description:
Welcome back to your private daily news briefing. Here's what’s happening today across technology, AI, global and US politics, geopolitics, economics, investing, leadership, writing, and public speaking.
Let’s begin with the opening headlines.
Anthropic's first technical product manager, Dianne Penn, shares insights on how the AI startup evolved from a small team of five engineers in 2023 to becoming the fastest-growing company in history. She discusses pioneering eval-driven development loops
